subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are repaired, should OpenClaw accept these 12 executable action revisions as one grouped privileged update?
rationale: SHA synchronization is mechanical, but accepting new third-party code that executes with credentials, publishing access, and security permissions requires explicit owner judgment under the protected security label.

options.title: Approve Reviewed Group
options.body: Review every upstream revision, require focused guard proof and exact-head CI, then merge the grouped update.

options.title: Split Privileged Families
options.body: Separate token, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex action families for narrower security and operational review.

options.title: Hold Current Pins
options.body: Retain the currently reviewed revisions until a later dependency-review window.

recommendation.title: Approve Reviewed Group
recommendation.body: Review every upstream revision, require focused guard proof and exact-head CI, then merge the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged workflow-permission and publishing work makes him the strongest available routing candidate for this decision.
